name: SaunaLife CL5G | 4-Person Outdoor Cube Sauna
description: Description Transform your backyard into a private Scandinavian wellness retreat. The SaunaLife CL5G Cube Sauna is a masterpiece of design and craftsmanship, offering a luxurious, authentic sauna experience in the open air. With a stunning panoramic glass front and a spacious interior for up to four people, this is your personal escape for relaxation and rejuvenation. Handcrafted in Northern Europe from premium, thermally modified woods, the CL5G is built to withstand the elements and become a beautiful focal point of your outdoor living space. It’s not just a sauna; it’s an investment in a lifestyle of wellness, designed to be enjoyed for decades to come. A Masterpiece of Design & Materials This sauna isn't just built; it's engineered for comfort, beauty, and extreme durability. Panoramic Glass Front: An 8mm tempered and tinted bronze glass wall creates a bright, open feel, offering picturesque views of your surroundings while you relax. Weatherproof Thermo-Spruce Exterior: The thick, solid wood exterior has been thermally treated, making it naturally resistant to decay, pests, and harsh weather without the use of chemicals. It's built for a lifetime outdoors. Cool-Touch Thermo-Aspen Interior: The satin-smooth benches and backrests are crafted from Thermo-Aspen. This premium, knotless wood remains comfortable to the touch and its ergonomic contours provide ultimate support during long, relaxing sessions. Advanced Lighting System: Set the perfect mood with a premium "dotless" white LED lighting system, fully controllable via Wi-Fi app or the included wireless remote. Please Note: Customize with Your Perfect Heater (Sold Separately) To give you the freedom to create your perfect sauna experience, the heater and controls are sold separately. This allows you to choose the ideal power and style for your needs. This sauna is engineered for a 6kW to 8kW wall-mounted electric sauna heater. We recommend pairing it with a premium heater like the HUUM DROP or the Harvia KIP series. Our experts are happy to help you select the perfect package! Assembly & Delivery Information This sauna kit is a rewarding DIY project that results in a professional-grade outdoor spa. We recommend 2-3 handy adults for assembly, which can typically be completed over a weekend. A solid, level foundation (like a concrete pad or deck) is required before you begin. This sauna ships via LTL freight and weighs approximately 1680 lbs. The delivery is curbside (dropped off at the end of your driveway), so please have a plan to move the components to your assembly site. What's Included?
